claim.statement: GitHub's current MCP guide says GitHub and Playwright MCP servers are configured automatically, the default GitHub MCP token is read-only for the current repository, repository administrators can configure additional MCP tools, and Copilot uses available tools autonomously without asking for approval before use.

source.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) and GitHub Copilot cloud agent
source.locator: Default MCP servers; Setting up MCP servers in a repository

values: default GitHub and Playwright MCP servers

limitations: The claim records publisher-described authority, not the behavior, trustworthiness or side effects of any MCP server.
GitHub's firewall guide says the integrated firewall does not apply to MCP servers.
unknowns: The effective MCP servers, tools, transports, code, credentials and destinations are unknown.
The autonomous tool-selection behavior, inputs, outputs and side effects of a particular task were not observed.
